### Evidence table

All citations refer to **S0191**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Aspect | Observed evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Task and intended scene | The student was asked to reconstruct an indoor scene from one RGB photograph as a runnable SceneAct/Blender program, with separate architecture, furniture and object meshes, materials, camera and lighting. The request specified a 384 × 512 image and a compact image specification before coding. These are requested goals, not observations of the photograph or an achieved scene (line 1, `model_request`, characters [0,9998)). |
| Actual operations and outcome | A fresh, read-only Codex student session was launched with the staged image. It failed with exit code 1 after about 14 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls. The subsequent `model_error` and `scene_error` show failure during `runtime.ask`, referring to a stderr log whose contents are not included (line 2, `codex_session`, [0,2650); line 3, `model_error`, [0,562); line 4, `scene_error`, [0,1620)). This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure. |
| Changes and validation | No student response, program, scene modification, build, render, visual comparison, score or final selection is visible. Therefore there is no evidence of partial correctness or an empty patch; the reconstruction outcome is unknown beyond the failed call (lines 1–4, cited above). |
| Scene-specific checks | Multiple objects, their materials or textures, part connections and pose, and camera, lighting or render problems cannot be evaluated: neither the reference image contents nor an output image are visible in these observations. Their inclusion in the instructions does not establish their presence or correctness (line 1, `model_request`, [0,9998)). |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher event, diagnosis, proposed update, execution or student adoption is recorded. The session reports no tool calls; no autonomous exploration is visible. This is a student trajectory, not a teacher-only trace (lines 2–4, cited above). |

**Transferable lesson and uncertainty.** A failed model invocation should be separated from a failed scene-building algorithm, and visual or geometric quality should not be inferred without an actual output. The task-specific unresolved issue is why Codex exited 1: the trace points to `stderr.log` but does not expose it. The image’s contents and any unrecorded downstream activity remain unknown.
